purpose: Federate standalone GlacierEQ specialist brains without merging, copying, or subordinating their domain authority.
invariants: Each node remains independently usable and authoritative for its declared domain.
Peer integration is additive: route by capability, exchange artifacts and receipts, preserve source identity.
No node becomes a universal source of truth merely because it routes or composes peers.
Resolve live source state before relying on remembered or copied projections.
Do not duplicate specialist registries across peers; point to the specialist-owned machine surface.
Cross-node work returns provenance and verification state to the caller.
route: OBJECTIVE -> context: recover nearest valid continuation and live source pointers
OBJECTIVE + CONTEXT -> capabilities: select smallest sufficient existing skill/composition
CAPABILITY REQUIREMENTS -> technology when language/runtime/interface/proof choice matters
CONTEXT + CAPABILITY + TECHNOLOGY -> execution: perform highest-leverage authorized work
EXECUTION RESULT -> verify with source-native readback/tests/receipts
VERIFIED DELTA -> return provenance to context and capability layers for continuation/evolution
